title: 第9章 魔兽袭击与周围领主第10章 周围领主
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
新卫兵的招募令已下达三天了，农奴们彻底沸腾，没到三天50人就招募满了。
这些刚从农奴中选出的新卫兵，此时正跟着劳恩练习基础的劈刺动作，他们大多赤裸着上身，手里的木矛挥得虎虎生风。
“手臂再用力！刺出去的时候，不许闭着眼！”劳恩的声音像磨过的砂石。
他提着长剑在队列中穿行，时不时用剑鞘拍打动作变形的新兵。
“别以为穿上皮甲就是卫兵了，遇到豺狼人，你们这点力气连塞牙缝都不够！”
罗恩站在瞭望塔下，指尖无意识地摩挲着剑柄。场中新兵训练的热情很高，但想形成战斗力还得不短的时间。
他转头看向身侧的佩林，老行政官正捧着账本，眉头拧成个疙瘩。
“说说吧，金龙还剩多少。”罗恩的声音平静，却带着不容置疑的催促。
佩林苦着脸翻开账本：
“大人，算上买农奴、牲口和魔药的开销，只剩两千二百三十七枚了，这钱得用到这一茬粮食收割。
“您吩咐的盐矿和砖窑的建设，目前人手严重不足，得等到农庄人手空出来才能去建设。”
罗恩沉默片刻，开拓的速度明显慢了下来。
一千多名农奴被钉死在五个农庄的建设里，番薯屯的引水渠刚挖到一半，黑麦屯的谷仓还缺屋顶，小麦屯的土地翻整进度还差四成。
人手被死死卡住，连去橡树林砍伐木料的杂役队都凑不齐人。
“让庄园的农奴先停一停非必要的活计，先去把5个农庄开垦好。”
他的目光投向西侧的黏土矿，那里的土堆已堆得像座小山，却迟迟等不到人手处理。
“等农庄的框架稳住了再说，眼下粮食和住处最要紧。”
“佩林，新卫兵的月俸定了吗？”罗恩转头问身边的老行政官。
“按照规矩，定了8枚银币，两个月后正常给10枚。”佩林翻开账本，笔尖在纸上沙沙作响。
“训练通过后不仅可以获得自由民身份，还能得到俸禄，他们都卯着劲想留下来。”

“嗯！”
罗恩心情烦闷。自从在河边遇到那个来意不明的领主之后。罗恩就觉得领地建设的速度还是太慢了。
练兵场的呼喝声渐歇，新兵们瘫坐在地上，大口喘着气。
劳恩走过来，朝罗恩行礼后说：
“这群小子还算能熬，就是底子太差，没个半年练不出模样。”
“半年太久。”罗恩指了指地图。
“鲍里斯的人既然出现在河边，就不会只看一眼。
派些人去打探打探周围领主的信息。尤其是临水领和绿湖领的底细，我要知道得更清楚些。
正在罗恩几人交谈的时候。
一个农奴跌跌撞撞地从番薯屯方向跑来，脸上沾着血，嘴里语无伦次：
“大、大人……魔兽老虎……袭击……”
罗恩脸色一沉，拔剑出鞘：“劳恩，派几个卫兵去其他屯叫人，你跟我走！”
content_en:
The recruitment order for new guards had been issued for three days, and the serfs were completely excited. In less than three days, all 50 people had been recruited.
These new guards, who had just been selected from the serfs, were practicing basic slashing and stabbing movements with Raun. Most of them were naked and wielded the wooden spears in their hands with great force.
"Try harder with your arms! Don't close your eyes when stabbing out!" Lao En's voice was like polished sand.
He walked through the queue carrying a long sword, and from time to time he used the scabbard to slap the recruits who had deformed movements.
"Don't think you're a guard when you put on leather armor. When you encounter a jackal, you won't even have enough strength to wedge it between your teeth!"
Ron stood under the watchtower, his fingertips unconsciously rubbing the hilt of his sword. The enthusiasm for the training of new recruits on the field is very high, but it will take a long time to develop combat effectiveness.
He turned to look at Palin beside him. The old administrator was holding a ledger with his brows knitted into a knot.
"Tell me, how many golden dragons are left?" Ron's voice was calm, but with an unmistakable urge.
Palin opened the ledger with a grimace:
"Sir, after including the cost of buying serfs, livestock and magic potions, there are only two thousand two hundred and thirty-seven coins left. This money must be used for this crop of grain harvest.
"The construction of the salt mine and brick kiln you ordered is currently severely understaffed, and we will have to wait until the farm is freed up to build it. "
Ron was silent for a moment, and his pace of development slowed down significantly.
More than a thousand serfs were imprisoned in the construction of five farms. The aqueduct in Fanshu Village was only half dug, the barn in Heimaitun still lacked a roof, and the land plowing progress in Maimaitun was still less than 40%.
Manpower was so tight that even the handyman team that went to the oak forest to cut wood couldn't find enough people.
"Let the serfs in the manor stop non-essential work and cultivate the five farms first. "
He set his sights on the clay mine on the west side, where the mounds of soil had piled up like a hill, but no one could handle them.
"We will wait until the framework of the farm is stabilized. Right now, food and shelter are the most important things. "
"Palin, has the salary of the new guard been decided? "Ron turned to ask the old administrator next to him.
"According to the rules, 8 silver coins were ordered, and 10 silver coins would be given as normal after two months. ” Palin opened the ledger, the tip of his pen rustling on the paper.
“After passing the training, not only can they get the status of a free citizen, but they can also get a salary. They are all trying hard to stay. "
"Um! "
Ron was feeling depressed. Ever since I met the unknown lord by the river. Ron felt that the speed of territory construction was still too slow.
The shouts and shouts in the training ground gradually subsided, and the recruits collapsed on the ground, gasping for air.
Ron came over, saluted Ron and said:
"This group of boys can still survive, but their foundation is so poor that they can't show their appearance within half a year of practice. "
“Half a year is too long. "Ron pointed at the map.
“Since Boris’ people appeared at the river, they would not just take a look.
Send some people to find out information about the surrounding lords. Especially the details of Linshui Territory and Green Lake Territory, I want to know more clearly.
While Ron and others were talking.
A serf stumbled over from the direction of Fanshu Tun, his face stained with blood and he spoke incoherently:
"S-Sir...the monster tiger...attacks..."
Ron's face darkened, and he drew his sword out of its sheath: "Laun, send a few guards to other camps to call people, you come with me!"
